module_summary: Pipelined unsigned 8x8 multiplier: registered operands, eight shifted partial products summed pairwise into registers, final sum register, gated output aligned by a 3-bit valid shift chain.

anchors.name: mul_en_in
anchors.why: Input valid gating operand capture and entering the valid chain.

anchors.name: mul_out
anchors.why: Registered product, mul_out_reg when valid else zero.

anchors.name: mul_en_out
anchors.why: Output valid, mul_en_in delayed through valid shift chain.

anchors.name: mul_en_out_reg
anchors.why: Valid shift chain; MSB gates mul_out load and drives mul_en_out.

anchors.name: mul_a_reg
anchors.why: Input-stage operand register; mul_b_reg is its twin.

anchors.name: temp
anchors.why: Eight partial products: shifted mul_a_reg gated by mul_b_reg bits.

anchors.name: sum
anchors.why: Stage registers holding pairwise partial-product sums.

anchors.name: mul_out_reg
anchors.why: Stage register holding total of partial sums before output gating.

groups.name: valid_pipeline
groups.description: Shift chain aligning enable with product latency.

groups.name: input_stage
groups.description: Registers operands when mul_en_in, else zero.

groups.name: partial_products
groups.description: Generates partial products and registers pairwise sums.

groups.name: final_sum_output
groups.description: Accumulates partial sums and gates product output.
